inputs.text: The Blue Waters owner says the Government takes taxes “without doing or investing in anything.” Now plastic bottles blocking rivers and drains are being used to float the idea of an environmental tax. Convenient: turn a failure to manage the problem into another excuse to collect money, while leaving the question of where existing taxes go unanswered. Don’t mistake a new charge for real investment or accountability.
